intro: On Koh Larn, where most stays mean a songthaew ride across the island to a far-off beach, finding a place you can walk to from the main pier in about 3 minutes is rare and genuinely handy — Toonja Koh Larn is a small seaside Bed & Breakfast set right in the heart of the Na Ban Pier area · what people talk about most is the free golf-cart pickup from the pier, free breakfast and the King sea-view room, at a price that's still doable on the island · it takes adults 18 and over only, so it stays quiet and suits couples and anyone who actually wants to rest · from about ฿1,100/night, rated 9.2 from 72 reviews on Trip.com

body.html: Who Toonja Koh Larn suits — the shortest way to put it: Toonja Koh Larn is for people who want to come to Koh Larn and "get from the boat to the room as fast as possible" without fussing over getting around the island · it's a small seaside Bed & Breakfast set in the Na Ban Pier area, the main part of the island where the ferries from Pattaya dock · what makes people pick it is the convenience from the first step off the boat, because you can walk from the pier to the room in about 3 minutes, and there's also free golf-cart pickup from the pier · real reviews line up on this: the people it fits are couples, solo travellers and anyone coming to Koh Larn for one or two nights to rest quietly, rather than a big family with small children, because the place takes adults 18 and over only, no children and no pets · another draw people mention is the King Room with Sea View, where you wake up to the sea, and free breakfast that's already included in the room rate · it's still open and scoring well, with Trip.com at around 9.2 from 72 reviews and Booking.com at about 8.8, which is high for a small island stay · you could say it plays the "convenient and good value" angle well, but you have to understand it's a small B&B that leans on cleanliness and location more than being a big resort with a pool and the wide range of facilities you'd get at a city hotel

Location and getting there — Toonja Koh Larn sits on Moo 7 by the main pier (Na Ban Pier), the island's main pier and busiest area · the location's strong point is that it's very close to Na Ban Pier, about a 3-minute walk, so once you're off the boat you reach the room almost right away, with no songthaew ride across the island and no dragging your bags far · what many people especially like is that the property offers free golf-cart pickup from the pier — just give them your arrival time in advance, so you don't have to walk in the sun on a hot day · getting to Koh Larn starts from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya: a regular ferry takes about 30–45 min, or if you're in a hurry a speedboat takes about 15 min, and both land at Na Ban Pier · once on the island, the stay is in the Na Ban Pier area, where restaurants, shops, convenience stores and motorbike-rental spots are all within walking distance, which is very handy for finding food and supplies · for the island's beaches, Tawaen Beach is about 1 km away and Ta-Yai Beach about 1.3 km, while Samae Beach, Nual Beach and other viewpoints are a short motorbike ride or songthaew away · one small note: the Na Ban Pier area is the busiest part of the island, with boats coming and going and plenty of tourists during the day, so if you want total silence like a far-off beach, this spot may not be the quietest — but you trade that for far easier travel and finding food

"Off the boat and a few minutes' walk and you're there, no need to pay extra for a songthaew · message them your boat time and they bring a golf cart to pick you up too. The room was clean, the sea view was pretty, and it was quieter than I expected for being right by the pier."

Room types and the look — Toonja Koh Larn has several room types to choose from by group size and budget · it starts with the Standard Room, around 16 sqm with a King bed, a simple, clean air-conditioned room that suits couples who just want a comfortable, affordable place to sleep · next is the Standard 2-Bed Room (1 Queen + 1 single) for people travelling together who want separate beds · the highlight room is the King Room with Sea View, which gets a sea outlook so you wake up to the water, and some rooms have a balcony to sit out on · the largest is the Family Room (2 Queen beds) for a group of adult friends travelling together · every room has the essentials — air conditioning, a fridge, a flat-screen TV, drinking water and a private bathroom with basic toiletries · many reviews agree that the rooms are clean, the beds comfortable and the upkeep good for a stay at this price on the island · the look is plain rather than design-led or luxurious, but it feels comfortable and not cramped · worth knowing: because it's a small B&B, most rooms are compact at around 16 sqm, not as roomy as a city hotel, and not every room has a sea view — if you want one, choose the King Room with Sea View when you book, as some Standard rooms face inward or look onto the garden

Facilities — to be straight from the start, Toonja Koh Larn is a small Bed & Breakfast, so there's no pool and none of the big-resort facilities like a gym or spa · but what it does have is geared toward an easy stay · the most talked-about is the free golf-cart pickup from the pier, which makes arriving and leaving much easier · beyond that there's free Wi-Fi in all rooms and common areas, free parking, an on-site restaurant and a diving-trip arrangement service for anyone who wants to head out and snorkel the reefs around the island · there's a common seating area and a spot by the sea to sit and watch the view in the evening · the front desk is open roughly 07:30–19:30, which is worth knowing — if you arrive later than that, give them a heads-up in advance · in terms of facilities, this is clearly a stay that leans on location, cleanliness and the pier pickup more than a variety of on-site activities, so it suits people who plan to use it as a base for the beaches and diving by day and come back to sleep at night, more than people who want to spend the whole day inside a resort

Food and breakfast — Toonja Koh Larn has an on-site restaurant and serves free breakfast already included in the room rate, roughly 08:00–10:00 each day · what reviews mention is that breakfast is handy because you don't have to head out far in the morning to find food, especially on days you're getting ready to catch a boat or go to the beach · that said, to be fair, some reviews note the breakfast is still plain and not very varied, which is understandable for a small stay at this price · the upside is that the Na Ban Pier area the stay sits in has restaurants, seafood spots, made-to-order eateries, cafés and convenience stores within easy walking distance, so many people head out for lunch and dinner — island prices run a little higher than the mainland, as is normal on a tourist island · overall, food here isn't a reason to eat in for every meal, but the free breakfast is a nice extra that saves money and time, and for other meals the central Na Ban Pier location makes finding food very easy

Service — service is another point that earns steady praise in real reviews, with Trip.com rating the service category around 9.2 · many people are impressed by the friendliness and helpfulness of the staff, especially the golf-cart pickup from the pier, the tips on places to go and where to eat, and help arranging diving trips or boats to the various beaches · because it's a small, adults-only stay, the care tends to be thorough and personal · but to be fair, some reviews note that checkout at certain times still isn't as smooth as it could be, and the front desk's evening closing (around 19:30) may not be convenient for people arriving late · the advice is to give them your boat arrival time in advance so they can have the golf cart there on time, and to confirm the check-in and checkout details clearly before you travel, to make the stay as smooth as possible

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — pulled together from Trip.com, Booking.com and other review sources, the picture is fairly consistent, with an overall score in the high range of around 9.2 from 72 reviews on Trip.com and about 8.8 on Booking.com · on the praise side: a location near the pier that's a few minutes' walk with free golf-cart pickup, clean and well-kept rooms, friendly and helpful staff, a pretty sea-view room where you wake up to the water, free breakfast that's handy, and a central Na Ban Pier spot that makes food and supplies easy to find · on the watch-out side: the things that come up are that the breakfast is still plain and not very varied, checkout at certain times isn't smooth, the rooms are compact at around 16 sqm rather than spacious, there's no pool because it's a small B&B, and although it's by the sea it doesn't have a private sand beach you can walk straight down to swim from in front — you have to walk or ride a motorbike to Tawaen or another beach · on top of that, it takes adults 18 and over only, no children, which families with small kids need to know before booking · most of these gripes are manageable by setting the right expectation — that you're staying at a small place built on location and cleanliness — rather than being big problems that sour the overall impression

"Loved how close it is to the pier, a quick walk and you're there · the sea-view room was worth the price and the staff were lovely and arranged a snorkelling boat for us · the only gripe was the breakfast being a bit plain, but it's easy to walk out and find places nearby. All in all good value for a one-night island getaway."

Price and value — Toonja Koh Larn starts at about ฿1,100–1,300/night for a Standard room on a weekday, rising to around ฿1,500–1,900 for the King Room with Sea View or the Family Room, especially Friday–Sunday and long weekends when island prices climb with demand · compared with other seaside stays in the Na Ban Pier area on Koh Larn, this counts as good value, since you get the location near the pier, free golf-cart pickup, free breakfast and a high review score of around 9.2 · in value terms, if you're coming to Koh Larn for one or two nights to rest and head out to the beaches by day, this handles the convenience well and saves money well, especially the sea-view room, which doesn't cost much more but gives you the full atmosphere back · but if you're coming to mark a special occasion and want a private pool villa or a big resort with the full range of facilities, the island has higher-priced options that fit better · in short, Toonja is a value pick in the "clean, well-located, affordable" group rather than the luxury, experience-led group

Good to know before booking — a few things make the stay smoother · one, it takes adults 18 and over only, no children and no pets, and there are no extra beds or cribs, so if you're a family with small kids, choose another stay on the island · two, give them your boat arrival time at Na Ban Pier in advance so the free golf-cart pickup can be there on time · three, if you want a sea view, book the King Room with Sea View specifically, as some Standard rooms face inward or look onto the garden · four, the front desk is open about 07:30–19:30 and check-in runs 14:00–19:30, so if you arrive late, give them a heads-up · five, allow for the checkout step that some reviews say still isn't smooth — confirm the times and details clearly at check-in · six, if you're heading to Tawaen, Samae or Nual Beach, plan to rent a motorbike or use a songthaew in the Na Ban Pier area, since the stay is on the pier side and not right on a swimming beach

The verdict — from all the real reviews, Toonja Koh Larn is the best fit for couples and adult travellers who want a clean seaside stay, the closest location to the pier, easy travel and an affordable price for an overnight trip to Koh Larn · the strong points are clear: a roughly 3-minute walk from the pier, free golf-cart pickup, free breakfast, a King sea-view room and a high review score of around 9.2 from 72 reviews · but you have to understand it's a small Bed & Breakfast with no pool, compact rooms, a breakfast that's still plain, checkout that isn't smooth at certain times, and an adults-only, no-children policy · if you're after a big resort with a pool, a private pool villa or a stay right on the beach where you can step onto the sand, this may not be the answer, and you should look at stays on the Tawaen or Samae Beach side instead · but for a getaway for two where you want convenience, cleanliness and the location that gets you off the boat and into the room fastest on a doable budget — Toonja Koh Larn does that well and is good value in its own way, which is why the review score stays high

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Toonja Koh Larn

faq.q: Where is Toonja Koh Larn and how do you get there?
faq.a: It's at 163 Moo 7 on the Na Ban Pier side, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri · it's very close to Na Ban Pier, about a 3-minute walk · get there by ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya (about 30–45 min) or speedboat (~15 min) to Na Ban Pier · the property offers free golf-cart pickup from the pier — just give them your boat arrival time in advance

faq.q: Does Toonja Koh Larn take children?
faq.a: It takes adults 18 and over only, no children, no pets, and no extra beds or cribs · the focus is a quiet, private feel that suits couples and people coming to rest · if you're a family with small kids, choose another stay on the island that takes families

faq.q: Does Toonja Koh Larn have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: It's a small Bed & Breakfast, so there's no pool · but there is free breakfast included in the room rate, served 08:00–10:00 (some reviews say it's still plain and not very varied) · the Na Ban Pier area where the stay sits has restaurants and convenience stores within easy walking distance for other meals

faq.q: What's the starting price at Toonja Koh Larn and what room types are there?
faq.a: From about ฿1,100–1,300/night for the Standard and Standard 2-Bed rooms · the King Room with Sea View is around ฿1,600 and the Family Room around ฿1,900, with prices rising over holidays · most rooms are compact at around 16 sqm with air conditioning, a fridge, a TV and a private bathroom · book ahead and compare across platforms

faq.q: Is Toonja Koh Larn right on a beach you can walk down to swim from?
faq.a: The stay is by the sea on the Na Ban Pier side, but there's no private sand beach to walk straight down to swim from in front of your room · if you want to swim, rent a motorbike or use a songthaew to ride to Tawaen Beach (about 1 km), Ta-Yai Beach, or Samae/Nual Beach, which aren't far
